nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.stage7_morphometrics¶

qvtpy stage 7: TOF eICAB morphometrics (cow_morpho port).

Inputs

  • eICAB WB (or CW fallback) multilabel mask under <output_root>/<subject>/eicab/.

Outputs

  • case_metrics_donut_tree.xlsx, centerline/surface VTPs, tortuosity tables, and radius histograms under <output_root>/<subject>/qvtpy/stage7_morphometrics/.
